english.toefl: 80 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 for tests on/after that date
english.note: Two-year scores; no MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. DET only when other exams unavailable; DET-only admits take TOEP. English-only US degree or foreign degree with sole English instruction recorded in WHED may exempt; other documentation not accepted. Programs/TA employment may set higher standards.

applicationFee.note: US applicants$135. Central waiver limited to listed graduate-preparation programs, not general financial need. Identify program/coordinator in application; participation verified. International applicants should confirm category eligibility.

requirements.note: PhD-only admission. General application materials; recommended interdisciplinary science preparation, deficiencies reviewed individually. Mentor chosen after rotations; prior faculty contact not required. Supporting-material grace ends December 3, 2026 at 23:59 Pacific. Application, fee and undergraduate/master degree-institution transcripts remain due December 1; only non-degree-institution transcripts may arrive late.

deadlines.label: General and fellowship
deadlines.note: Current 2027–28 central table; follow earlier department closing rules.

funding.note: Group supports rotations; PI responsible after lab placement, normally via GSR/TA/fellowship. Historical fall 2026/winter 2027 rotation offer: $11,000 per quarter plus tuition, fees and health insurance if needed; not a fall 2027 stipend promise. International recruitment harder because rotation and thesis funding constraints; confirm availability.
